comment: The cases of the members of packages/rust/interface.json that need no database (docs/spec/core.md CORE-70 to CORE-72), one group per member in the case form of binding G-5: the keys of a case are the parameters of its member, a receiver is an instance value {new, args, then}, a keyed map is a list of [key, value] with the key {int}, and a class result is observed by after. A failure is raises: its kind, its category and its whole message (CORE-12).
